messages:
maya-docs: opened PR #4399 to update the Private migration guide with a new SDK snippet and terraform example. flagging for legal/security review because the example contained an ARN-like string. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399
triage-pr: thanks maya. can you paste the snippet (sanitized) so we can triage quickly?
maya-docs: pasted (sanitized):
```yaml
kms_key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:555666777888:key/abcd-EXAMPLE
endpoint: https://private.redwood.internal
```
olga-legal: please don't ship real-looking ARNs. open a redaction ticket and replace with a synthetic placeholder (arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:012345678901:key/EXAMPLE or <REDACTED_KMS_ARN>). include whether this was copied from a customer or fabricated.
sam-security: i'll run a quick scrub of the branch for account ids/ARN patterns and attach results to the ticket. also recommend using the obvious-fake account 012345678901 in examples.
dan-eng: small formatting nit 1 the fenced block in the MD used mixed indentation; that causes the preview to show literal backticks. i'll push a tiny patch to normalize to ```yaml and update the SDK field name to kms_key_arn (client expects that).
ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck failed  1 broken anchor: #terraform-setup referenced from private-migrate.md: line 172. Full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/4399/logs/linkcheck
maya-docs: opened REDACT-345 and linked the PR, included diff and note that the value was fabricated but looked realistic. https://tracker.internal.redwood/REDACT-345
olga-legal: ack REDACT-345. i'll review now. if it's fabricated and replaced with synthetic values we can approve same day; if it's customer-sourced we'll need written permission and that expands the timeline.
sam-security: branch scrub attached to REDACT-345  found one additional ARN-like string in examples/terraform/main.tf. marked it in the ticket. recommend hold until examples dir is cleared.
dan-eng: removed terraform example and replaced with a short pseudo-code block referencing <REDACTED_KMS_ARN>. pushed fix and normalized code fences. tagging ci-bot to rerun.
ci-bot: docs-preview: rerun queued for PR #4399. current status: linkcheck in progress.
olga-legal: REDACT-345  closed  confirmed synthetic replacements and audit note added. legal clear to merge once CI is green.
sam-security: scrub complete  no remaining ARN/account patterns. final report attached to REDACT-345.
ci-bot: docs-preview: all checks passed for PR #4399.
github: PR #4399  maya-docs updated private-migrate.md (branch: docs/private-kms-example). Status: checks passed, awaiting code review approvals. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399
harper-release: heads up  Private docs release cut is at 18:00 UTC today. if this must be included, we need approvals and merge before 16:30 UTC to make the candidate. otherwise we can include in the post-release patch.
dan-eng: reviewed and approved the API name changes. @maya-docs can you add a short changelog line and reference REDACT-345 in the PR?
maya-docs: added changelog and linked REDACT-345. requesting one more reviewer approval and will merge once we have it. thanks everyone. :shipit:
